title: Cimitri - Workflows
note: v1 paths only. Quote handoff, out-of-state forms, and engineer/CEP-6 wait. Vault, pump, and tank-only jobs never enter the CEP-5 path.

workflows.name: 01 Office day
steps: Create or open a customer and site.
Create a job: type, one calendar date, people, one or more trucks.
Put it on the board as scheduled.
Mark the job complete from the office if the crew already finished in the field.
If the job is Alabama OSS install or repair, open the CEP-5 draft. Otherwise stop.

workflows.name: 02 Crew day
steps: Pick crew mode and which person you are.
Open today's jobs assigned to that person only.
Tap scheduled → en route → on site → complete.
Update in under a minute. If there is no signal, update back at the shop.
On Alabama OSS install or repair only (later slice): add photos and notes. Layout sketch iterates later.
Do not sign in the app. Print and wet-sign on paper.

workflows.name: 03 CEP-5 close-out
steps: Only when job type is OSS new install or repair and the site is in Alabama.
Office prefills identity, permit, tank, and system-type fields from the job. Copied, not invented.
Crew adds photos and notes in the first slice. Layout sketch iterates later.
Print or export PDF. The licensed installer wet-signs on paper. Prefill is a draft. It is not ADPH approval. Cimitri does not capture a signature.
Someone still submits the signed form to the LHD within 3 business days. Cimitri does not file it in v1.
